title: World Music 2
description: Revise World Music styles, instruments and musical features up to National 5. Regional labels cover diverse traditions.

items.prompt: Pairs of small shell-shaped clappers, traditionally made from wood, held in the hand and clicked together.
A North Indian plucked long-necked lute with movable frets, melody strings and sympathetic strings.
A North Indian pair of hand drums of different sizes and pitches, traditionally called dayan and bayan, produces contrasting finger and palm strokes.
Two or more different rhythmic groupings are performed simultaneously. Name this layering device.
A rhythmic line shifts emphasis away from expected strong beats, for example by accenting weak beats or holding a note across a strong beat. Name the device.
Name the general musical device of restating a phrase or section unchanged.
The performer makes up music while playing instead of following a fully written part.
A scale made from five different notes within the octave.
